basis: uncorrected misstatements of prior periods are carried forward and shown apart from the current year's own (SA 450 paragraph 11(b); spec section 4.1; acceptance 5); each carried item states its current-period effect and its cumulative effect on profit before tax and on net assets, entered by a person with the basis: this module computes neither (register B6); the totals sum those figures gross, with no netting between items, and net, signed (spec section 4.1); 'with prior-period items' adds each total to the aggregate of the current year's uncorrected misstatements, so the evaluation is shown both ways and no one method is chosen; a carried item is not banded and none is left out as clearly trivial; the gates of spec section 7 test the current year's aggregate and do not read these figures, because which basis a gate should test is the firm's policy and is not decided (architecture D61)
